treatment_summary: Continue lisinopril for hypertension, add atorvastatin for primary CVD prevention, start metformin to halt progression of pre‑diabetes, and introduce semaglutide for weight loss and additional glycaemic benefit. Monitor renal and liver function before initiating metformin and atorvastatin, verify no contraindications for semaglutide, and review all agents regularly per NICE recommendations.
